evals.prompt: Build an app shell with a sidebar navigation on the left (240px wide) and a main content area on the right. The sidebar should have a logo at the top, navigation links in the middle, and a user avatar at the bottom.
evals.expected_output: App shell using .wa-flank with wa-align-items-stretch. Semantic HTML (nav, main, aside). Sidebar with .wa-split for top/bottom distribution.
expectations: Uses semantic HTML elements (nav, main, aside) with appropriate roles or aria-label
Uses .wa-split or .wa-stack with justify for distributing sidebar content (logo top, links middle, avatar bottom)
Uses className (not class) on all elements
Does NOT use @media queries for basic responsiveness (wa-flank handles it)

evals.prompt: Create a dashboard layout with a header showing the page title 'Analytics', then a row of 4 metric cards (Total Users, Revenue, Conversion, Active Sessions), and below that a two-column grid with a chart area and a recent activity list.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard using .wa-stack for vertical flow, .wa-grid for card row and two-column below. Card components for metrics.
expectations: Uses .wa-stack for the overall vertical page flow
Uses .wa-grid with --min-column-size for the metric cards row
Uses Card component for metric cards (not raw divs)
Uses a grid or .wa-grid for the two-column chart+activity section
Includes npx kigumi add for Card and other needed components
Uses className (not class) on all elements

evals.prompt: Build a landing page with a dark hero section at the top (title, subtitle, CTA button), a 3-column features grid in the middle, and a footer with links.
evals.expected_output: Landing page with .wa-dark on hero section, .wa-grid for features, semantic footer. Layout utilities for spacing.
expectations: Uses .wa-dark class on the hero section to invert colors
Uses .wa-stack for vertical page flow and section spacing
Uses Button component for CTA (not raw <button>)
Does NOT fabricate layout utilities like .wa-hero, .wa-section, or .wa-container
